'''Amfar''' was an [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] vacation [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

==History==
Amfar quickly grew into a tourist destination due to its warm [[Beach/Legends|beaches]] and tropical [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. Building an economy off of tourism and vacationers, the planet thrived throughout the history of the Republic. It wasn't until [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], that the planet suffered an economic downturn for the world. [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] interviewed tourists [[Huberdink Bufflin III]] and his wife, [[Milli Bufflin]], who had found that they had the beaches and restaurants all to themselves. Resort owner [[Byll Shotaleve]] was also interviewed, reporting that his resort beaches were so slow that the native [[Redfish/Legends|redfish]] were reclaiming land once populated by tourists.<ref name="HNN52" />
